item.title: PyPad 1.8.1 Released
item.description: - Important: PyPad 1.8.1 improves startup/recovery behavior and editor responsiveness. - Typing Speed Test tabs are now excluded from autosave/crash recovery state. - Startup recovery no longer leaks a phantom or premature main window behind dialogs. - Full-document status stats are preserved while heavy refresh work is deferred off the keystroke path. - Play actions now include dedicated SVG icons and richer debug logging covers startup, recovery, and editor refresh flow. - Detailed changelog: CHANGELOG.md
